static_traits.name: Liu Zhicheng
static_traits.occupation: 真人秀Actor(曾在马戏团担任小丑)
static_traits.social_status: 有支持性的朋友和家人可倾诉,但尚not yet与他们讨论该具体的内疚与Fear
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病;既往not yet接受心理治疗;without类似心理问题史
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude;表达清晰,愿意配合并能自我Reflection;报告Persistent anxiety与自责;思维中存在灾难化,跳结论与过度概括

basic_info.main_problem: 在马戏团担任小丑时一次not慎吓到了许多孩子,此后长期陷入内疚与Fear,认为雇主再也not会信任自己.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of guilt and fear significantly affect my mental health and cause distress. I want to come out of it and feel better.
growth_experiences: 在马戏团表演时因角色投入过深,做了带有巨大声响与突然动作的把戏,导致许多孩子被吓到.事件发生时压力很大,担心丢掉Work并让他人失望.自此之后,持续出现内疚与Fear,反复回想当日场景,在类似环境(马戏团现场,看到小丑服装)或想到过去行为时加重.曾尝试向孩子和家长道歉,弥补,但情绪not yet明显缓解.担心声誉受损,雇主not再信任.

special_situations.event: Being in an environment similar to the event (circus scene, seeing clown costumes)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am in a similar scene again, I will definitely make mistakes again and be fired
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids related scenes and work content, maintaining high vigilance to reduce mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will mess up again,老板会解雇我

special_situations.event: Repeatedly replaying that day's performance mistake
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次错误就证明我not可靠,not yet来也not会被信任
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断自我检讨和责备,试图通过严苛自律避免再犯错
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次失误毁了我的声誉,not人会再信任我

special_situations.event: not yet从雇主处获得明确的安抚或保证
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not被明确表态原谅,就表示他们对我失去信任
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 对雇主和同事保持警惕与not信任,以Self-protection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are waiting for me to make another mistake and then fire me

special_situations.event: In high-pressure situations of worrying about losing his job and disappointing others
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果让do not人失望,就会被永久negate与not再信任
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proactively apologizes to children and parents, tries to remedy to regain trust

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be forgiven, trusted, and to maintain professional reputation
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected与抛弃,失去Work,被永久贴上'not可靠'的标签
defense_goal: Avoids being hurt again by staying vigilant and somewhat distant
Uses self-criticism and high standards to control risk

object_relations.object_representation: 严苛,随时会惩罚或negate自己的审判者(雇主/他人)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes 'the employer may have moved past this' and invites examining the evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将对方not yet给出明确保证理解为他人not信任自己(移情:将not被信任的FearProjection到他人意图上)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use怀疑的语气强调他人'在等我出错',反复提出担忧,Demands更多外部保证,暂缓情感深入探讨.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈及那次失误与Self-blame emotions时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turns anger and disappointment toward others into self-criticism; believes she should be punished
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Describes their own faults in self-blaming language, lowers outward emotional expression, and emphasizes 'I should demand more strictly of myself'.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to look for counter-evidence or consider alternative explanations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 用看似合理的理由维持负面结论,如'他们not安抚我,所以一定not信任我'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Lists surface evidence to support the negative hypothesis, firm tone, ignores contrary information.

manifestations: 拥有支持系统却not yet与其讨论具体的内疚与Fear
对雇主与同事难以建立信任,担心not被再次信任
outcomes: Disturbed sleep and affected daily activities

manifestations: Bound by fear of mistakes and negative predictions, avoiding similar environments
在Work中因担心被not信任而减少自主性与尝试
outcomes: 选择空间与行动Freedom感降低

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Cautious in interactions with others, hard to trust employers and colleagues
not愿向支持系统透露具体困扰

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'
manifestations: Believing that my employer and colleagues are waiting for me to slip up again and will fire me
在缺乏明确证据时推断他人对自己not信任

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: not与朋友和家人讨论具体的内疚与Fear
Converts the urge to seek support into self-endurance and self-punishment

positive_force: Has supportive friends and family,可作为潜在支持资源
Able to take responsibility and proactively try to make amends (has apologized to children and parents)
Willing to participate and try cognitive reappraisal and behavioral experiments (expressing 'worth a try')
negative_force: Thinking patterns of catastrophizing, jumping to conclusions, and overgeneralization
对外部保证的依赖与not信任他人(外部验证倾向)
Avoids similar situations and topics, causing the problem to persist
Persistent anxiety与Sleep disturbance,损害职业表现

target_behavior.behavior: 灾难化与跳结论的思维反应(伴随Significant anxiety)
antecedent: Recalling the day of the circus mishap
Being in an environment similar to the event (circus, seeing clown costumes)
not yet收到雇主的明确安抚或保证
target_behavior.core_reason: 内在核心信念'我not值得被信任'与对单次失误的过度概括,导致对not yet来的负性预测
target_behavior.function: 逃避not确定性与潜在威胁,获得短期的控制感
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety与内疚持续,睡眠和日常活动受扰,Decline in work performance,与他人信任受损

target_behavior.behavior: 回避讨论与接触trigger线索(环境与人际话题)
antecedent: Others mention related topics or suggest communicating with the support system
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被再次negate或not被信任,对最坏情况的预测
target_behavior.consequence: 资源not yet被利用,情绪问题维持甚至加重,Intensified sense of isolation
